evidence_type: sanitized native Process Loopback smoke observations; not GUI, DAW, waveform performance, or general audio-quality acceptance

scope.fixture: std-only process with no audio stream and no playback
scope.target_guard: exact child PID plus workspace target executable named backtracking-quiet*
scope.capture: dedicated Process Loopback only; no System Audio fallback
scope.snapshot_storage: memory only; On-phase pinned snapshots checked as zero
scope.runner_writes: workspace fixture executable, logs and stop marker

observed_assertion_stages: manual Pause stable with quiet ON

ownership_findings.basis: source analysis and independent review reported by implementation owner
ownership_findings.cause: PROPVARIANT owning Drop calls PropVariantClear for a VT_BLOB whose pointer borrows params inside a Rust Box
ownership_findings.fix: outer ManuallyDrop<PROPVARIANT>; property borrows &*variant; completion callback retains the Box until the last COM reference drops, preserving Box as sole owner
ownership_findings.regression_result: passed, reported by implementation owner; current final local Windows suite reported separately in local-validation.json

sanitization.published: whitelisted timestamps, classifications, scalar observations, assertion names and hashes
sanitization.raw_input_hashes: hashes identify private local logs without publishing their content

limitations: The first attempt failed and remains part of the record; only the fixed version completed this native case.
Fixture executable hashes differ between attempts; no source hash was recorded for the failed attempt.
Observed intervals and frame counts are case measurements, not a zero-latency guarantee.
This ownership fix is not evidence of the cause of earlier multi-second UI freezes, paging, or startup behavior.
No WAV is written; this case does not verify WAV duration, selected export, audible artifacts, or universal no-dropout behavior.
No macOS, Fn shortcut, DAW host, physical device range, native waveform GUI or broad system-source acceptance is established.
Current local suites, final local package/desktop refresh and completed cross-platform CI are recorded separately; this scoped native smoke does not expand their runtime coverage.
